description: This file defines the 'Article' model class within the Opencart e-commerce platform, handling database operations related to articles, comments, ratings, and associated data in the CMS module.

classes.name: Article
classes.description: Model class for managing articles, comments, ratings, and related database interactions within the CMS module of Opencart.

methods.name: getArticle
methods.description: Retrieves a specific article record from the database by article ID.

methods.name: getArticles
methods.description: Fetches multiple article records based on optional filters, with caching.

methods.name: editRating
methods.description: Updates the rating of a specific article.

methods.name: getTotalArticles
methods.description: Returns the total count of articles matching optional filters.

methods.name: getLayoutId
methods.description: Retrieves the layout ID associated with a specific article.

methods.name: addComment
methods.description: Inserts a new comment for an article into the database.

methods.name: editCommentRating
methods.description: Updates the rating for a specific comment.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Fetches a specific comment by its ID.

methods.name: getComments
methods.description: Retrieves comments for an article with optional filters and caching.

methods.name: getTotalComments
methods.description: Counts total comments for an article with optional filters.

methods.name: addRating
methods.description: Adds a rating record for a comment.

methods.name: deleteRating
methods.description: Removes a rating record for a comment.

methods.name: getRatings
methods.description: Retrieves rating records for an article and optional comment ID.
